integrity: The full proof is included. A finite exhaustive checker verifies twenty small examples but does not substitute for the infinite proof. Publication priority remains uncertain where relevant older literature is inaccessible or uses equivalent orbit terminology.
scientific_limitations: The exact shell law concerns size-two matrices over finite commutative chain rings. The automatic deep square-zero region is counted as one aggregated block; higher matrix sizes and non-chain local rings are not covered. A normalized limiting law fixes residue cardinality and lets ring length grow.
title: Uniform valuation shells of square-zero matrices over finite chain rings
